{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates on patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of arms and severity
print("\nArm distribution:")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if arms are balanced by severity (confounding check)
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))"}
